counts.graph.scans: How many times the in-memory facts were searched from end to end.
counts.graph.quadsvisited: How many individual facts those searches looked at.
counts.store.queries: How many questions were put to the pod's fact store.
counts.bridge.query.rows: How many rows the Bridge's queries returned in all.
counts.bridge.workers: How many helper processes the Bridge used.
counts.bridge.package.found: Whether the Bridge's package was found, 1 if so.
counts.built.lines.total: How many lines the import built for the pod's files, counted each time a file is built. It is more than the statements the pod's files hold (the stored scenario's statements/all) because some files are built more than once: a file a later build replaced is built again, and some files are rebuilt on purpose. A record's file is built once, and the copy held for its revision is the bytes written. That the large size has the same cause is likely and not measured.
counts.built.lines.written: How many answer-file lines were written.
counts.built.lines.sorted: How many answer-file lines had to be sorted.
counts.view.quadsmoved: How many facts were set aside and put back while answer files were rebuilt.
counts.podfiles.files: How many pod files were read.
counts.podfiles.calls: How many times pod files were read.
counts.adapter.files.read: How many adapter files were read.
counts.components.resolved: How many of the runtime's parts were found on disk.
counts.core-pod.compactions: How many times the pod's files were tidied together.
counts.incremental.boundvalues.iris: How many record names a narrowed question was given.
counts.incremental.boundvalues.batches: How many batches those names were given in.
counts.incremental.boundvalues.calls: How many narrowed questions were asked.
counts.matcher.valuesblocks: How many groups of records the matcher compared at a time.
counts.matcher.valuesblockrecords: How many records those groups held in all.
counts.matcher.valueslistssplit: How many times a long list of records was split to fit.
counts.matcher.queriesrun: How many questions the matcher asked.
counts.matcher.takenrecords: How many records the matcher picked to compare.
counts.matcher.boundrecords: How many records the matcher's questions were limited to.
counts.shapes.machine-basis-check: How many times a judgment's stated basis was checked against its shape (a repeat check over the same statements is not counted).

countFamilies.says: How many individual facts the searches inside '{name}' looked at.
How many times the in-memory facts were searched end to end inside '{name}'.
How many times the matcher put this question to the pod's facts.
